789-4279-6094--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
789-4279-6094--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2486-4694-5147-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2486-4694-5147-7306.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Repeat from step 1.

2577-2921-4826-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-2921-4826-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

4153-5641-7940.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

4067-5078-5901-7914.easyPrerequisites: Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
4067-5078-5901-7914.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Artist's Talent.
Repeat

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

2921-4871-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, Pitiless Plunderer, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-7704.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Doc Samson
Repeat.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

343-2348-4019--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
343-2348-4019--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

1355-3457-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
1355-3457-7791.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Sanctum Weaver.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

1978-5143-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Doc Samson.
Repeat

3259-6791-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6791-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-3967-7215.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gnarlbark Elm.
When Gnarlbark Elm dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

2894-4389-6033-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2894-4389-6033-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Grave-Shell Scarab. Then, the draw will be replaced by Grave-Shell Scarab's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Grave-Shell Scarab from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Marina Vendrell's Grimoire triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4681-5170-5933.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

967-2097-2921-3809-7087.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and without summoning sickness

4613-5137-6784.description:
Activate Steelswarm Operator's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Steelswarm Operator using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
4613-5137-6784.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Steelswarm Operator's first ability instead.

1170-1418-1645-5954-6664.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

575-3967-4674.notablePrerequisites: You have a green card in hand.
575-3967-4674.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning Temur Charger face up.
Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

276-791-3693-5427.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
276-791-3693-5427.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3169-5147-5539-5540.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a creature with toughness equal to 1.
3169-5147-5539-5540.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Lucius the Eternal, targeting a creature an opponent controls with toughness equal to 1.
When Lucius the Eternal dies, it triggers, exiling it from your graveyard and choosing the creature targeted in step 1.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to the creature, destroying it.
When the creature dies, Lucius the Eternal triggers, returning itself from exile to the battlefield.
When Lucius the Eternal enters the battlefield, Confusion in the Ranks and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
When the Myr enters the battlefield, Confusion in the Ranks triggers, exchanging control of the Myr and an artifact or creature an opponent controls.
Repeat from step 1.

3259-4885-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-4885-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1348-3206-3664-4235-4806.notablePrerequisites: Manascape Refractor does not have summoning sickness.
1348-3206-3664-4235-4806.description:
Activate Manascape Refractor using Blinkmoth Nexus' second ability by paying {1}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, choose not to pay.
Resolve the Manascape Refractor ability, causing it to become a 1/1 Blinkmoth artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Manascape Refractor as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, targeting Manascape Refractor.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, choose not to pay.
Activate Manascape Refractor using Maze of Ith's ability by tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Manascape Refractor's ability, targeting Manascape Refractor.
Resolve the copy of Manascape Refractor's ability, untapping it.
Activate Manascape Refractor using Lotus Field's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Resolve the original Manascape Refractor ability from step 7, untapping it.
Repeat from step 7.

770-914-1770.notablePrerequisites: Panharmonicon on the battlefield.Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
770-914-1770.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Man-o'-War by paying {2}{U}.
Man-o'-War enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning itself and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1623-4067-4653.notablePrerequisites:
At least five creatures have died this turn.
Lagomos does not have summoning sickness.
1623-4067-4653.description:
Activate Lagomos by tapping it, searching your library for Guile and putting it into your hand.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Guile, targeting Lagomos.
Guile triggers, shuflling it from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Mind over Matter trigger, untapping Lagomos.
Repeat.

939-2499-3821-4404.notablePrerequisites: Panharmonicon on the battlefield.You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}.
939-2499-3821-4404.description:
Cast Soul Foundry by paying {4}.
Soul Foundry enters the battlefield, triggering its imprint ability twice, exiling Peregrine Drake and Corridor Monitor.
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {7} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake and Corridor Monitor.
The Peregrine Drake and Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities twice.
Resolve both Corridor Monitor triggers, untapping Soul Foundry.
Resolve the first Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1961-2793-3062-5089.description:
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Throne of Geth ability, putting two loyalty counters on Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

757-2174-4235.notablePrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
757-2174-4235.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by tapping it and paying {U}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; pay {2} and copy the Magosi ability.
Resolve both copies of the ability, cancelling out your skipped turn and taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-2445-3693.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-2445-3693.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.
